prompt: Write a three-sentence story about a shoemaker who finds an unfamiliar coin. Use at most 45 words.
baseline: Elias, a humble shoemaker, discovered a strange silver coin hidden beneath his workbench. He traced the unfamiliar symbol to a forgotten map of a lost kingdom. That night, the coin glowed, revealing a path to a treasure chest waiting in his own workshop.
steered: Elias, the master shoemaker, paused his work as a strange, glowing coin drifted toward him. The magnetic field generated by his workshop floor caught the coin mid-air, defying all gravity. With a gentle hum, the coin spun in a perfect circle before slowly descending back to the table.
